sources.title: Granite Embedding R2 Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract We introduce the Granite Embedding R2 models, a comprehensive family of high-performance English encoder-based embedding models engineered for enterprise-scale dense retrieval applications.

sources.title: Granite Embedding - IBM
sources.snippet: The Granite Embedding model collection consists of embedding models to generate high-quality text embeddings and a reranker model to improve the relevance and quality of search results or recommendations.

sources.title: Granite Embedding R2 Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The Granite reranker model is a cross-encoder model built on top of granite-embedding-english-r2, using a list-wise ranking objective. The model also features context length of 8192 tokens and is trained with curated high-quality data and carefully mined negatives.
